source_governance.rationale: Existing production expectations are recovery debt, not precedent for new lint suppression.
source_governance.safety_invariant: Only the exact reviewed item, lint, reason, scope, category, and syntax signature may remain; the occurrence count can only fall.
source_governance.alternatives_considered: Refactoring the flagged production behavior is preferred and will retire the expectation when its maintainability phase reaches that component.
source_governance.evidence: The adoption inventory records every production expect attribute after cfg-aware syntax classification.
source_governance.re_review_phase: Phase 1 suppression audit and component-by-component maintainability recovery

source_governance.rationale: Existing test expectations remain temporarily to preserve behavior while the high-signal test suite is rebuilt and compared.
source_governance.safety_invariant: A test expectation must stay attached to its reviewed helper or case and must not weaken production code.
source_governance.alternatives_considered: The test audit will replace broad helpers and incidental lint debt with focused assertions before old tests are removed.
source_governance.evidence: The adoption inventory separates test-only cfg branches and integration targets from production syntax.
source_governance.re_review_phase: Phase 2 high-signal test architecture and legacy-test comparison

source_governance.rationale: Existing benchmark expectations cover harness-only output, setup, and measurement behavior and remain recovery evidence until benchmark review.
source_governance.safety_invariant: Benchmark expectations cannot authorize product or test code and their reviewed occurrence counts cannot grow.
source_governance.alternatives_considered: Harness-specific wrappers or benchmark-local APIs should replace expectations when they improve signal without distorting measured code.
source_governance.evidence: The adoption inventory classifies each explicit benchmark target independently.
source_governance.re_review_phase: Phase 3 benchmark signal and performance-baseline audit
